title: Patient Payment Plan Schedule of Terms: Term, Installment Floor, Down Payment and Due Dates
content:
The figures below shape the schedule of every **Patient Payment Plan** tier. The maximum term is the maximum number of monthly installments, the down payment excluded. The minimum monthly payment is the floor of the monthly installment. The down payment percentage is the percent of the enrolled balance due as a down payment at signing (0 means none). The first-due gap is the minimum number of calendar days between the signing date and the first installment due date. The due day options are the days of the month the patient may choose as the installment due day.

| Tier | Maximum term (monthly installments) | Minimum monthly payment (USD) | Down payment (percent of enrolled balance) | First-due gap (calendar days) | Due day options |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Riverbend Short-Term Payment Plan | 6 | 25.00 | 0 | 25 | 1st or 15th |
| Riverbend Standard Payment Plan | 12 | 50.00 | 0 | 25 | 1st or 15th |
| Riverbend Extended Payment Plan | 24 | 75.00 | 10 | 25 | 1st or 15th |
| Riverbend Long-Term Payment Plan | 36 | 100.00 | 10 | 25 | 1st or 15th |
| Riverbend Assistance-Linked Payment Plan | 48 | 20.00 | 0 | 30 | 1st or 15th |
| Riverbend Hardship Payment Plan | 60 | 10.00 | 0 | 30 | 1st or 15th |

## Installment rounding basis

On every tier the rounding basis of the monthly installment is the same: the installment is rounded half-up to the cent, and the final installment absorbs any remainder.

## Worked illustration (hypothetical figures)

A hypothetical financed amount of 1000.00 over 12 installments gives 83.333..., rounded half-up to 83.33; eleven installments of 83.33 come to 916.63, so the final installment absorbs the remainder and is 83.37. On the Standard tier that installment clears the 50.00 floor.
